description: Create a menu bot: an opening template with quick-reply buttons that route each tap to a reply. Provide openingTemplateName and options (each button + its reply template/text). Start the menu for a contact by sending the opening template (e.g. via a campaign). Each option's free-text reply can be enhanced (Bot Builder parity): aiCompose + aiComposePrompt (Gambot AI phrases it live) and outsideHoursMessage (different text outside business hours). Add reminders[] to send follow-ups on the primary/main flow if the contact goes quiet ('תזכורות בפלואו הראשי').

openingTemplateName.description: Template that shows the menu buttons.

aiCompose.description: Let Gambot AI phrase this option's reply live (regular replies only).

aiComposePrompt.description: Short instruction for aiCompose on this option.

button.description: Button title on the opening template.

outsideHoursMessage.description: Alternative reply text OUTSIDE business hours for this option.

reminders.description: Follow-up reminders on the primary/main flow if the contact doesn't respond.

name: gambot_create_menu_bot
title: Create menu bot
